name: Amazon Bedrock
tagline: Managed foundation models via AWS API
description: Amazon Bedrock is a fully managed AWS service for invoking foundation models (Anthropic Claude, Amazon Titan, Meta Llama, and others) through a unified API with AWS SigV4 authentication. Runtime endpoints are regional under bedrock-runtime.

auth.details: AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) with IAM credentials; no simple API key. Use AWS access key/secret or temporary STS credentials. Service name is bedrock for control plane and bedrock-runtime for InvokeModel/Converse.

pricing.paid_plans: Pay-per-token and provisioned throughput; model- and region-specific. See AWS Bedrock pricing.

use_cases: invoke a foundation model for chat completion
run multi-turn converse API with tools
embed text with a Bedrock embedding model
stream token responses from a model
list and get foundation model metadata via control plane
